meta.title: Recreate Order: Schedule ticked with tomorrow 11:00 AM

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ summary for the buyer.
Open the Recreate Order popup from the event's stage settings menu.

args.goal: In the Recreate Order popup, verify Product Sheet, Auction Configurations, Delivery Date and Schedule this event? are present; tick Schedule this event?, select tomorrow at 11:00 AM, click Create Order, and stop on the newly created event showing it is Upcoming and starts tomorrow at 11:00 AM

steps.note: Perform and verify the popup-specific scheduling and creation flow that has no dedicated catalog step.
Verify the newly created upcoming event offers Reschedule Event.
